    • Method Detail

      • prepare

        public <T> io.reactivex.Maybe<T> prepare(Request request,
                                         Supplier<? extends AsyncHandler<T>> handlerSupplier)
        Description copied from interface: RxHttpClient
        Prepares the given request. For each subscription to the returned Maybe, a new HTTP request will be executed and the results of AsyncHandlers obtained from handlerSupplier will be emitted.
        Specified by:
        prepare in interface RxHttpClient
        Type Parameters:
        T - the result type produced by handlers produced by handlerSupplier and emitted by the returned Maybe instance
        Parameters:
        request - the request that is to be executed
        handlerSupplier - supplies the desired AsyncHandler instances that are used to produce results
        Returns:
        a Maybe that executes request upon subscription and that emits the results produced by the supplied handlers

      • createBridge

        protected <T> AsyncHandler<?> createBridge(io.reactivex.MaybeEmitter<T> emitter,
                                           AsyncHandler<T> handler)
        Creates an AsyncHandler that bridges events from the given handler to the given emitter and cancellation/disposal in the other direction.
        Type Parameters:
        T - the result type produced by handler and emitted by emitter
        Parameters:
        emitter - the RxJava emitter instance that receives results upon completion and will be queried for disposal during event processing
        handler - the AsyncHandler instance that receives downstream events and produces the result that will be emitted upon request completion
        Returns:
        the bridge handler
